name: How long does a typical window leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window leak repair depends on the complexity of the issue. Simple resealing can often be completed in a few hours. More involved repairs, such as replacing flashing, repairing frame damage, or re-installing a window, might require a full day or multiple days, especially if materials need to be custom-ordered. We aim to complete repairs efficiently while ensuring a lasting solution and will communicate an estimated timeline once we understand the scope of work after an inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary; simple fixes take hours, while complex issues like frame repair or re-installation can take one or more days.
